Bug_Details: Math.round(Integer) results in truncation Math.round() called with an integer or long type results in truncation because Math.round only accepts floats or doubles and some integers and longs can’t be represented with float.
Bug_Explanation: This code demonstrates the Math.round bug by adding two integers and then dividing the sum by 2. The result is then passed to Math.round, which will truncate the resulting integer if it falls between two integers, leading to incorrect results.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug here is that Math.round method only rounds to an integer, it truncates any decimal value. So when we add two large integers and divide the sum by 2, the result will fall between two integers and hence Math.round will truncate it.
